falsifier.text: ZEB.TO closes below its 50-day moving average and breadth falls under 0.25 before the 30-day horizon.

theses.subject: Technology
theses.thesis: Technology (XIT.TO) is trend-eligible but is the most crowded theme (z=1.36) with a marginally negative score (-0.037) and 'mixed' trend texture. Per guardrails, crowding is not a short signal, but combined with no positive momentum and a contested macro narrative (ai_tech is one of several unscheduled drivers), the prudent lean is to stand aside rather than add.

falsifier.text: XIT.TO prints a new 20-day high with breadth above 0.8 and an improving durability bar before the 21-day horizon.
